hypothesis: The Trigger-6 create-only claim design is semantically fail-closed but, when many workers write unrelated files directly to one hot main branch through the GitHub Contents API, branch-head compare-and-swap contention can starve otherwise nonoverlapping claims.
counterhypothesis: The two 409 responses are transient connector/API races and bounded retry with re-entry is sufficient; no protocol-level coordination change is needed.
falsifier: Under comparable fan-out, measure claim acquisition success/latency for bounded re-entry retries. If unrelated-path claims acquire reliably without repeated branch-head conflicts, reject protocol-level starvation as material.
recommended_non_authoritative_design_del: Preserve create-only semantic identity and fail-closed duplicate prevention.
Do not weaken claims into last-writer-wins updates.

Consider a protocol-v2 atomic semaphore whose uniqueness is independent of the hot main contents commit, for example an immutable uniquely named Git ref per normalized research_id+claim_target, followed by canonical claim materialization/reconciliation on main.

Alternatively retain the current protocol but define bounded re-entry retries and an explicit COORDINATION_STARVED terminal state so infrastructure contention cannot be mistaken for occupied research scope.
